metadataReview.note: A Montenegrin history article states that the 1796 battle took place in the village of Kruse, between Podgorica and Cetinje, and Wikipedia locates the battle at Krusi in the Lješanska nahija. The atlas point is the gazetteer node for the village of Kruse in the Capital City of Podgorica. It is a village-sector reference; no memorial is used as the position. The existing date is retained despite differing Old Style and New Style statements in the sources. Strengths, losses and equipment are not inferred; the article's numbers are not adopted.

The Montenegrin article names the village of Kruse as the battle site. This is a named-village reference point, not a surveyed troop position or a centre of the whole engagement. No positional accuracy radius is claimed.
